## Checklist

- [ ] Tests are added or updated, and they pass locally
- [ ] Linters pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Documentation is updated (README, runbook, SOP or ADR as needed)
- [ ] For infrastructure changes: `terraform plan` output or a description of the cluster impact is included below
- [ ] For detection changes: the evaluation in `eval/` has been run and the results are included below
- [ ] User-facing text never calls something "100% safe" or calls a person a "scammer"
